Package com.javiergs.rtde4j

Class URScriptClient

java.lang.Object
com.javiergs.rtde4j.URScriptClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class URScriptClient extends Object implements AutoCloseable
TCP transport for sending URScript programs to a Universal Robots controller over the secondary interface. This class does not parse robot-state messages, acknowledge execution, or determine whether a script has completed. Sending URScript can move the robot; use only with an appropriately safeguarded robot.
Version:
1.0.0 (2026.10.26)

javiergs

    • sendCommand

      public void sendCommand(String command) throws IOException
      Sends a single-line URScript command or statement, terminated by LF. A successful return confirms only that bytes were written to the socket, not that the robot accepted or executed the command. This method does not accept multi-line scripts.
      Parameters:
      command - nonblank single-line URScript statement
      Throws:
      IOException - if writing fails or the client is closed

    • moveJoints

      public void moveJoints(double[] joints, double acceleration, double velocity) throws IOException
      Sends a joint-space movej command. Values are in radians, radians per second squared, and radians per second. This method does not wait for motion completion.
      Parameters:
      joints - six target joint angles in radians
      acceleration - positive joint acceleration in radians per second squared
      velocity - positive joint speed in radians per second
      Throws:
      IOException - if command transmission fails

    • moveTool

      public void moveTool(double[] tcpPose, double acceleration, double velocity) throws IOException
      Sends a Cartesian movel command using a TCP pose (x,y,z,rx,ry,rz). Position is in meters; orientation is a rotation vector in radians. Acceleration and velocity are Cartesian units (m/s squared and m/s). This method does not wait for motion completion.
      Parameters:
      tcpPose - six-element TCP pose
      acceleration - positive Cartesian acceleration in meters per second squared
      velocity - positive Cartesian velocity in meters per second
      Throws:
      IOException - if command transmission fails

    • moveToPose

      public void moveToPose(CartesianData pose, double acceleration, double velocity) throws IOException
      Sends a Cartesian linear movement to a pose represented by CartesianData. This is equivalent to moveTool(pose.get(), acceleration, velocity). The TCP offset fields in CartesianData are not applied. The method sends a command but does not confirm robot motion or completion.
      Parameters:
      pose - target TCP pose in meters and rotation-vector radians
      acceleration - positive Cartesian acceleration in meters per second squared
      velocity - positive Cartesian velocity in meters per second
      Throws:
      IOException - if command transmission fails

    • jogMoveContinuous

      public void jogMoveContinuous(double[] jointSpeeds, double acceleration, double duration) throws IOException
      Sends one bounded joint-velocity jogging segment using URScript speedj. Repeat only while a separate dead-man/hold-to-run control is active. The controller-side time parameter limits this segment; this API does not implement a watchdog, motion-state feedback, or a safety-rated stop.
      Parameters:
      jointSpeeds - six joint speeds in radians per second, each at most MAX_JOG_SPEED in absolute value
      acceleration - positive joint acceleration in radians per second squared
      duration - segment duration in seconds, greater than zero and at most MAX_JOG_DURATION
      Throws:
      IOException - if command transmission fails

    • stopJogging

      public void stopJogging(double deceleration) throws IOException
      Requests a decelerated joint stop using URScript stopj. This is not an emergency stop, and delivery/execution is not confirmed.
      Parameters:
      deceleration - positive joint deceleration in radians per second squared
      Throws:
      IOException - if command transmission fails
